recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source change is needed; any similar present-day problem belongs in current IG Publisher or affected IG tooling/source.
issue_request: FHIR-12907 asked that profile spreadsheets and the IG Publisher generate/render correct URLs for complex extension child slices, because the generated StructureDefinition/rendered output was missing those URLs.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 11497. The corresponding git commit f4523b525d1a643dc3583ef0d99f5481f5a3a3e2, dated 2017-03-02, is '#12907 - fix complex extensions from spreadsheets' and adds fixed Extension.extension.url values from child slice names in IgSpreadsheetParser.
additional_context: FHIR-12496 is the same reporter/workgroup/time-window issue family and reported omitted child extension names such as ombCategory. In current core, source/fhir.ini comments out the old us-core spreadsheet entry and the old Java files touched by the fix commit are no longer present. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested fix was already applied historically and the affected old spreadsheet/tooling path is no longer an active current core source surface.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published issue from the same reporter and tooling family about complex extension child names/URLs and bindings not rendering correctly.
